_what: The residue countdown for the two-harness window (ADR 0003, docs/decisions/). These are what is LEFT of the old probe harness. HarnessResidueTests derives all four numbers from the source tree every run. THREE GATE, exact equality in both directions - growth is a failing test, and a shrink that is not recorded here is one too: probeFiles, ciAllRows, and guardFilesOutsideTheCount. ONE ONLY REPORTS: probeLines is derived and printed beside them, never asserted, and updated here by a conversion PR as information. W7 is not complete while any of the three gated numbers is above zero.
_how: probeFiles = *Probe*.cs under src/housecarl-generator (recursive, bin/obj excluded) - GATED. guardFilesOutsideTheCount = the ci-all registry guards whose host file that glob does not count, derived from CiAll.ProbeTypes (the dispatch delegates themselves) - GATED, and reported by name. Two earlier shapes of that check asked the wrong question - the glob alone, then a method named RunGuard - and nine of the 132 rows dispatch something else, two of them from src/housecarl-core, where no naming discipline in the generator could ever have seen them. ciAllRows = CiAll.ProbeNames.Count, the dispatch registry read off the compiled generator, which is what ci-all runs and what its summary's N/N reports - GATED. A regex over CiAll.cs was the first derivation and it missed any row it did not match, a trailing comment included. probeLines = the total lines of those same probeFiles - REPORT-ONLY.
_why_lines_only_report: probeLines moves in both directions on ordinary in-place guard edits, which the two-harness rule requires: if you are editing an existing guard, you edit it where it already lives. Gating it made the correct act a failing build. This PR is the instance - probeLines went 65227 -> 65237 when BindingShimProbe's alias CENSUS was re-baked in place (publishing housecarl_check activates five alias rows for its schema), plus the ten-line explanatory comment that file's convention asks for. probeFiles and ciAllRows did not move, and that is the distinction: they move only when a family actually leaves the old harness. Ruled report-only rather than gated (ADR 0003). It moved again in this same PR, 65237 -> 65245, when round 1 found six generator comments that publishing the tool had made false and they were corrected where they live; nothing failed, which is the point. What would make this wrong: new guard work leaking into the old probes as in-place growth during the window - then probeLines re-gates on growth only.
_lowered_by: A conversion PR: it deletes the probe, adds the tests, and lowers these in the same commit - probeLines included, which stays honest as information even though it does not gate.
